question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Beautiful
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ugly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Beautiful"** means pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically; something that is attractive and lovely. (सुंदर)

 
 
• **Example: **The sunset over the mountains was incredibly beautiful.
 
 
 
• **"Ugly" **refers to something that is unpleasant or repulsive, especially in appearance. (बदसूरत)
 
 
• **Example: **The abandoned house looked ugly and eerie.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'beautiful'** is **'ugly'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ugly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stingy **(कंजूस): Unwilling to spend or give.

 
 
• **Example:** He is so stingy that he never tips the waiters.
 
 
 
• **Slimy **(चिकना): Covered with or resembling slime.
 
 
• **Example: **The slimy surface of the pond made it difficult to walk around.
 
 
 
• **Pungent** (तीखा): Having a sharply strong taste or smell.
 
 
• **Example:** The pungent smell of garlic filled the kitchen.
